name: SPARK : The IUCEE Student Chapter
description: SPARK : IUCEE RVCE Student Chapter at RVCE promotes project-based learning, innovation, research, leadership, and industry exposure. Industrial Connect is a key vertical, giving students first-hand exposure through visits to Indian Coach Factory (ICF), Infosys Mysore, Kaiga Nuclear Power Plant, and U R Rao Satellite Centre (URSC), Bengaluru, along with interactions with industry professionals and real-world engineering practices. Activities & Events include workshops, hackathons like Edu-AI-thon, and competitions. Projects & Research focuses on innovation, prototyping, and technical projects. Women Empowerment drives initiatives like Shakti Shiksha. Social Media & Podcast connects students through the Insight Podcast, creating opportunities to learn, network, lead, and grow.

events.name: Mission: Impossible? – Build. Adapt. Pitch.
events.detail: Think you can turn chaos into a startup? Pick random problems, technologies, audiences, revenue models, and wildcards, then connect the dots and build an idea that actually works.  But it doesn’t stop there. Test your memory, adapt to new constraints, create your poster, and pitch your startup in a gallery-style showdown.  Random chits. Unexpected twists. One winning idea. Can you build the impossible?.

events.name: Digital Launchpad Masterclass: LinkedIn, College Email Benefits & Leveraging AI
events.detail: Build a professional LinkedIn profile, unlock exclusive software and learning benefits through your college email ID, and learn to leverage AI tools for research, productivity, and academic workflows. This hands-on session equips you with practical skills to enhance your digital presence and work smarter throughout your college journey.

events.name: Stations of an Innovator
events.detail: Stations of an Innovator is an interactive experience where participants get to explore the complete journey of an innovator - from identifying a problem to creating a solution and understanding its impact. Through five engaging stations, participants will brainstorm innovative ideas, build simple prototypes using everyday materials, pitch their solutions like a startup, share their thoughts on future innovations through an Impact Wall, and finally explore the club’s projects, achievements, research, events, and opportunities. The experience is designed to make innovation interactive, creative, and hands-on, rather than just something to observe.

events.name: Decode.exe
events.detail: Two decoding stations, each filled with clues leading to hidden numbers. Crack both challenges, combine your answers, and uncover the final winning key. First team to solve them all wins!  Station 1: Two ancient ledgers hold countless stories—but hidden within them is something that doesn’t belong. Can you uncover the anomalies and reveal the truth? Station 2: A mysterious deep-space log holds hidden patterns, strange transmissions, and secrets waiting to be uncovered. Can you decode the unknown and discover what the expedition left behind?
